booking.title: New booking
booking.description: Pick the nights, see what is free, then take it. The room is chosen later.
booking.pickDates: Pick an arrival and a departure.
booking.freeCount: {free, plural, =0 {none free} one {# free} other {# free}}
booking.noPlan: No plan — a room with no price
booking.noPriceYet: Choose a type and a plan to see the total.

card.cancelDescription: The nights it holds go back on sale, and a booking that returns is a new one.
card.noShowTitle: Mark this booking as a no-show?
card.noShowDescription: It cannot be checked in afterwards — the guest arriving late is a new booking.
card.occupancyValue: {adults, plural, one {# adult} other {# adults}}{children, plural, =0 {} one {, # child} other {, # children}}
card.quotedHint: What the booking was quoted. The bill below is what is actually owed.

day.cancelDescription: The room goes back on sale for those nights.
day.noShowDescription: The booking ends and the nights are released.

grid.cancelDescription: The nights it holds go back on sale, and a booking that returns is a new one.
grid.noShowTitle: Mark this booking as a no-show?
grid.noShowDescription: It cannot be checked in afterwards — the guest arriving late is a new booking.
grid.keyboardHint: With a booking selected: arrows move it, Shift and arrows lengthen or shorten it, Enter sends the change, Escape puts it back.
grid.help: Click a booking for what can be done to it. Drag it onto another room to assign it, onto its type’s unassigned row to take the room back, sideways to move the nights, or by an edge to lengthen or shorten it.

walkIn.title: Walk-in
walkIn.description: Books tonight, assigns the room and checks the guest in.
walkIn.noSellableRoom: No sellable room of that type. Another type, or free one first.
